name: advisor
description: One fresh, read-only consultation for material technical decisions in Codex CLI and Codex desktop.

interface.longDescription:
Codex Advisor automatically adds a fresh, read-only second opinion when Codex identifies a material technical decision.

It activates for architecture, interface and API design, data models, compatibility changes, migrations, security boundaries, and competing diagnoses. Standard remains Terra/high and Specialist remains Sol/high. A separate advisor-astra role offers explicit-only Astra/high consultation for the most complex uses; it is never selected automatically, uses more Codex allowance, and remains subject to account and runtime availability.

Every consultation runs in a separate read-only, tool-free process. It cannot change your files, run commands, browse the web, or make decisions for you. You remain in control: Advisor does not implement, deploy, or perform final review.
defaultPrompt: Should we split this service into microservices?
Which API design is safer for this integration?
